subtopics.title: Types of number: Types of number (Core)

outcomes.text: Identify and use natural numbers, integers, primes, squares and cubes.
Identify and use common factors, common multiples, rational and irrational numbers, reciprocals.
Convert between numbers and words, write numbers as products of prime factors, and find HCF and LCM.
Use set language, notation and two-set Venn diagrams to describe sets.

subtopics.title: Powers and roots: Powers and roots (Core)

outcomes.text: Calculate with squares, square roots, cubes, cube roots and other powers and roots, recalling common values.

subtopics.title: Fractions, decimals and percentages: Fractions, decimals and percentages (Core)

outcomes.text: Use the language and notation of proper and improper fractions, mixed numbers, decimals and percentages.
Recognise equivalence and convert between fractions, decimals and percentages.

subtopics.title: Ordering and the four operations: Ordering (Core)

outcomes.text: Order quantities by size and use the symbols =, not equal, >, <, at least and at most.

subtopics.title: Ordering and the four operations: The four operations (Core)

outcomes.text: Use the four operations with integers, fractions and decimals, with correct order of operations and brackets.

subtopics.title: Indices and standard form: Indices I (Core)

outcomes.text: Understand and use positive, zero and negative integer indices.
Understand and use the rules of indices.

subtopics.title: Indices and standard form: Standard form (Core)

outcomes.text: Use standard form A x 10^n and convert numbers into and out of it.
Calculate with values in standard form.
Round values to a specified number of decimal places or significant figures.
Estimate calculations with numbers, quantities and measurements.
Round answers to a sensible accuracy for the context.

subtopics.title: Estimation and accuracy: Limits of accuracy (Core)

outcomes.text: Give upper and lower bounds for data rounded to a specified accuracy.

subtopics.title: Ratio, rates and percentages: Ratio and proportion (Core)

outcomes.text: Give ratios in simplest form, divide a quantity in a ratio, and use proportional reasoning in context.
Use common rates: pay, exchange rates, flow rates, fuel consumption.
Apply other rates: pressure, density, population density.
Solve average speed problems.
Calculate a percentage of a quantity, and express one quantity as a percentage of another.
Calculate percentage increase and decrease.
Calculate with simple and compound interest, discounts, profit and loss.

Interpret the calculator display appropriately.
Calculate with units of time and the relationships between them.
